invariant: Every StateSkin line-role color resolves through the same Java asColor rule as the fill role and is serialized with the SvgGraphics stroke rule. The boundary is the StateSkin defaults; explicit per-state (`##color`), per-arrow (`-[#color]->`) and stereotype style strokes are outside it.
causal_divergence: The predraft account 42344228e declared strokes unchanged, but the packet made resolve_pseudo_state_color delegate to the fill resolver while it still serves start_stroke and end_stroke. Pseudo-state circle strokes therefore moved to the Java rule (circle_root_rebecca: #663399 to Java #FFFFFF; circle_root_alpha: lowercase to Java uppercase 8-digit) while the state border and arrow strokes in the same diagram stayed on sequence::resolve_color (#663399, lowercase). The delegation also lost the old transparent-to-none stroke mapping: a transparent circle LineColor would now be written as #00000000 where SvgGraphics.fixColor writes none.

Fill roles keep resolve_pseudo_state_color/resolve_state_fill_color. Stereotype, per-state and per-arrow strokes remain residual.
